name: Malazan Book of the Fallen
overview: The Malazan universe is a massive, complex epic fantasy setting created by Canadian authors Steven Erikson and Ian C. Esslemont. Known for its staggering scale, profound focus on compassion, and deeply entrenched military grit, it spans over 20 mammoth novels that explore thousands of years of history, brutal warfare, and the machinations of gods and ancient races.
